links.label: Yeon-joo saves Kang Chul's life after being pulled into the webtoon world where he lies bleeding from a stab wound
links.evidence: She quickly checks to make sure he's still alive... She grabs a towel and a pair of scissors and runs back up to put pressure on the stab wounds

links.label: Kang Chul and Yeon-joo fall in love across two worlds, kiss, and eventually marry
links.evidence: He marches over to her and tilts her face up to meet his in a kiss

links.label: As a teenager, Yeon-joo unknowingly sketched the character who would become Kang Chul, based on her ideal man
links.evidence: That night she began to sketch out his characteristics: He was a national sports shooter... she decided he'd be 185cm tall

links.label: The manhwa is rewritten as a dream so Kang Chul forgets Yeon-joo completely, forcing her to carry their love alone
links.evidence: He asks her to draw him waking up from a dream... to make it so that everything from meeting her on the roof is all one long dream

links.label: Kang Chul and Yeon-joo register a marriage, first as a cover story and later in truth
links.evidence: the lawyer explains... they'd already registered their marriage in the U.S. last year

links.label: O Seong Mu is Kang Chul's creator, the webtoon artist who drew him into existence
links.evidence: the father of cardiothoracic surgeon O Yeon Ju, mysteriously goes missing while writing the last chapter of his webtoon 'W'

links.label: Seong Mu repeatedly tries to kill off Kang Chul in the webtoon, wanting to end the series and his own torment
links.evidence: He's sick and tired of Kang Chul and wanted to kill him in the manhwa's final scene

links.label: It's revealed that Seong Mu was the second, unseen attacker who stabbed Kang Chul on the rooftop the night they first met
links.evidence: Kneeling over Chul's body, Dad had said in a shaky voice, 'Let's end this,' and stabbed him right in the gut

links.label: Enraged at learning the truth of his creation, Kang Chul shoots Seong Mu in his workshop
links.evidence: In one swift motion, he pulls his gun out as he whirls around again... He shoots, and Dad looks down at his bleeding chest in shock

links.label: Kang Chul comes to think of Seong Mu as his own family, the father of his wife Yeon-joo
links.evidence: Not because you're the god who made me, but because you're the father of my wife. You're already my family.

links.label: Seong Mu sacrifices his own existence inside the webtoon to give Kang Chul and Yeon-joo their happy ending
links.evidence: He reaches out a hand, but she's too far away, and he just says quietly, 'I love you, my daughter. Goodbye.' He shuts his eyes and accepts his fate, and then he fades away.

links.label: O Seong Mu is Yeon-joo's father, the famous webtoon artist behind W
links.evidence: [Yeon Ju's father]

links.evidence: [Yeon Ju's mother]

links.evidence: [Yeon Ju's aunt]

links.label: Possessed by the killer he drew a face for, Seong Mu nearly strangles his own daughter
links.evidence: Dad is strangling her and ranting like a psycho that he shot her already and doesn't know why she's not dead

links.label: Seo Do Yun serves as Kang Chul's personal bodyguard
links.evidence: [Kang Cheol's bodyguard]

links.label: Do Yun trains Kang Chul in martial arts and becomes his closest, most trusted friend
links.evidence: Chul sought out top fighter Do-yoon for martial arts lessons... the boys developed a natural friendship as they trained

links.label: Yun Su Hui works as Kang Chul's longtime secretary
links.evidence: [Kang Cheol's secretary]

links.label: So-hee has secretly loved Kang Chul since high school, though he never returns her feelings
links.evidence: What am I? What was I to you?

links.label: Kang Chul fires So-hee after she turns Yeon-joo over to the police to protect him
links.evidence: That means you don't have the right to be my assistant. Just remain as my friend. You're fired.

links.label: Kang Chul insists So-hee is irreplaceable to him, saving her from vanishing as her narrative purpose fades
links.evidence: You're important to me. You're the person closest to me. I need you for the rest of my life.

links.label: Prosecutor-turned-Assemblyman Han Cheol Ho has hunted Kang Chul for a decade, convinced he murdered his own family
links.evidence: [Prosecutor / Kang Cheol's rival]

links.label: Assemblyman Han conspires with the faceless killer, not knowing he shares Seong Mu's face, to bring down Kang Chul together
links.evidence: New-Face says he knows everything that's about to happen to them... he offers to help make Assemblyman Han the next president

links.label: Assemblyman Han kidnaps and tortures Do Yun to lure Kang Chul into a trap
links.evidence: He yanks the hostage's head up, and it's Do-yoon

links.label: Kang Chul threatens to expose Assemblyman Han's crimes on tape in exchange for Do Yun's freedom
links.evidence: Chul warns him that he has multiple copies, and threatens to turn it over to the police if Assemblyman Han ever attacks one of his people again

links.label: Seong Mu forces Assemblyman Han to shoot himself, erasing the dangerous knowledge he has gained about the two worlds
links.evidence: Assemblyman Han's hand starts to flicker and pull the gun up to his own temple, against his will

links.label: Son Hyeon Seok, Kang Chul's late father's best friend, mentors him and runs his crime-investigation show W
links.evidence: His name is Sohn Hyun-seok, and he's Chul's dad's best friend, who now runs that crime investigation TV show

links.label: Possessed by the killer wearing Seong Mu's face, he shoots Ajusshi during a staged confession
links.evidence: a bullet comes out of nowhere and shoots Ajusshi right in the heart. He flatlines immediately

links.label: Su Bong becomes Yeon-joo's steadfast confidant, helping her navigate both worlds throughout her ordeal
links.evidence: Su-bong drags his feet as he returns to Dad's workshop... he sits next to her quietly, letting her cry

links.label: Once merely a fanboy of the webtoon, Su Bong becomes personally devoted to helping Kang Chul survive in the real world
links.evidence: Kang hyung... can I shake your hand? I've been your fan for a long time.
